description: This file defines composable UI components for navigation elements in an Android app, including navigation bars, rails, and scaffold, with custom styling and scope management.

classes.name: NiaNavigationSuiteScope
classes.description: Wrapper class for declaring navigation items within a navigation suite scaffold.

methods.name: NiaNavigationBar
methods.description: Composable function for a styled navigation bar with items.

methods.name: NiaNavigationBarItem
methods.description: Composable function for a navigation bar item with icon, label, and color customization.

methods.name: NiaNavigationRail
methods.description: Composable function for a styled navigation rail with header and content slots.

methods.name: NiaNavigationRailItem
methods.description: Composable function for a navigation rail item with icon, label, and color customization.

methods.name: NiaNavigationSuiteScaffold
methods.description: Composable scaffold that adapts layout for navigation components with scope for items.

methods.name: NiaNavigationSuiteScope
methods.description: Scope class for declaring navigation items within a scaffold.

methods.name: NiaNavigationBarPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for the navigation bar component.

methods.name: NiaNavigationRailPreview
methods.description: Preview composable for the navigation rail component.

methods.name: navigationContentColor
methods.description: Returns the color for navigation content from theme.

methods.name: navigationSelectedItemColor
methods.description: Returns the color for selected navigation items from theme.

methods.name: navigationIndicatorColor
methods.description: Returns the indicator color for navigation components from theme.
